content: In a footnote to the Prologue Melvin-Koushki quotes Ibn Turka's Persian treatise On Letters as schematizing three loci of self-manifestation created for the letterform, keyed to the letters of the word ʿabd: the first is Sight (the ʿayn), the second Heart or Mind (the bāʾ), the third Hearing (the dāl). He concludes this gives the 'Pearl-Planet-Peach' progression.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Persian treatise On Letters (title as given by Melvin-Koushki; the page does not say it is the R. Ḥurūf)
